items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You and St. Cyr and Ori and Johnny Dodds was on the date. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, yes. Those, that's right.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Bill Bull is right now.

Oh, I was going to ask a little bit about those records you made with Lil Armstrong. You and St. Cyr and Ori and Johnny Dodds was on the date. Yes, yes. Those, that's right. I... Papa Dip. Uh-huh. And let's see, Perdido Street Blues and Gate Mouth. Yeah. There were quite a few of those. Yes, yes, yes. Yeah, that was Lil's outfit. Were you working with her at the time? At the Dreamland? Let's see. No, let's see what...I don't know.
I don't think I was with her then. I can't remember where...no.
